(B) Pro forma operating earnings, net earnings and earnings per Common Share for the three months ended December 31, 1995, exclude the effects of nonrecurring charges of $17,552,000 ($12,495,000, net of tax) associated primarily with the one-time expenses incurred in connection with the merger with Medicine Shoppe International, Inc.
